title: Are AI tech giants hijacking drug discovery? - Nature Biotechnology
gist: A one-sentence standfirst for a feature arguing that the largest AI companies are moving into drug discovery and that investors are following their capital into the space.

insights.claim: The largest AI companies are placing capital bets on drug discovery, and investors are following them into the sector.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Watch for AI-platform capital setting valuations in biotech discovery rather than traditional life-science investors.
insights.quote: The AI titans are placing their bets on drug discovery, and investors are coming along for the ride.
